title: feat(spec): ExplainAccessRequest declares recordIds, the batch selector the explain wire schema already carries
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99U9EnFooYs4VpVTYdtMEsX)_
Fixes #29297

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/` or `content/docs/` spells the members of the `ExplainAccessRequest` contract type; `content/docs/permissions/explain.mdx` shows the kernel call with `object`/`operation`/`userId` only, and the batch form is already a wire-schema fact of `ExplainRequestSchema` (grep `explain` and `recordIds` in both trees, on 29000bb1).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`security` 服务契约的 explain 请求类型 `ExplainAccessRequest` 补上可选的 `recordIds`(批量记录 id),类型直接取自线上 schema `ExplainRequestSchema` 的同名成员。
- 为什么改:线上 schema、REST 解释路由和参考安全服务早已支持批量形态,唯独它们之间的 TypeScript 契约没声明,调用方只能强转才能传批量请求。
- 风险与回滚:仅类型放宽,无运行时改动;此前能编译的调用照常编译。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`(新成员与文档注释)、`packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.test.ts`(类型钉)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:test-typecheck`,预期 OK;把新成员改成 `readonly string[]` 再跑,预期该测试文件报 3 个类型错误。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ExplainAccessRequest` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`) gains `recordIds?: ExplainRequest['recordIds']`, with a doc comment: mutually exclusive with `recordId`; at least one and at most `EXPLAIN_BATCH_MAX_RECORD_IDS` ids (linked, not spelled); answered by `ExplainDecision.records` in the same order; an implementation may ignore it and answer only the object-level decision, and the caller then asks each id singularly, as the REST explain route does.
- The member's type is the wire schema's own (`ExplainRequest` = `z.input<typeof ExplainRequestSchema>`), not a hand-written `string[]`. Only this member is derived: tying the whole interface to the schema would change `operation` (the contract's `ExplainOperation | string` against the schema's closed enum) and replace the contract's member docs.
- The last doc sentence is measured against both readers on 29000bb1: the REST door hands the service the batch and falls back per id when the answer carries no `records` of the right length (`packages/rest/src/security-routes.ts` L256–299, the call at L279, the check at L280, the per-id loop at L289–296); the reference service reads the member and refuses it beside `recordId` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-explain-access.ts` L128, L142–145, L526–527).
- No runtime change. `check:api-surface` agrees with no regeneration (it records export names; no export was added or removed).
- Changeset: `.changeset/29297-explain-access-request-record-ids.md`, `@objectstack/spec` patch.

## Tests

- New in `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.test.ts` (no existing test was edited):
  - `ExplainRecordIdsIsOptional`: a type alias that reds if the member becomes required.
  - `ExplainRecordIdsMatchesWire`: a type alias holding `ExplainAccessRequest['recordIds']` equal to `z.input<typeof ExplainRequestSchema>['recordIds']`.
  - `explain accepts a batch request…`: the same equality through `expectTypeOf`, a batch literal reaching the service, and a `@ts-expect-error` that a bare string is not a batch.
- The file is compiled by `check:test-typecheck` (`tsconfig.test.json`) and is not in `test-typecheck-debt.json` (0 hits), so the aliases are live checks.
